name: SRX Global Inc.

profile.description: SRX Global (formerly SRX Health Solutions) completed its acquisition of EMJ Crypto Technologies on June 18, 2026 and rebranded as an AI-driven holding platform investing in operating companies and technology-enabled assets. Headquartered in North Palm Beach, Florida; financial data is sparse and no operating revenue figures were available [1].

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track Record (1/3): strategic pivot via the EMJX acquisition in June 2026, with no demonstrated results yet [1]. AI Deployment (0/2): an 'AI strategy' adopted but no shipped products or savings found. Market Share (0/2): none. Pipeline (0/2): no dated products. R&D (0/1): none.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (1/4): generic investment-platform language about long-term shareholder value through high-conviction operating companies [1]. Community (0/2), Retention (0/2) and Insider Buying (0/2): no evidence found.

infrastructure.label: WEAK
infrastructure.analysis: Almost all metrics are unavailable (revenue growth, ROE, D/E, forward P/E null); profit margin of 0.0% scores 0, so the available-metric score is 0. Daily dollar volume of about $6.3M passes the liquidity floor, but there is insufficient data to credit infrastructure [1].

ai_resilience.label: HIGH RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (4/9): the business model is unclear after rebranding from a health and food-adjacent company to an AI-driven holding platform, so exposure is hard to assess; a crypto and AI-themed holding company with no demonstrated moat faces substitution risk and has no analyst coverage on AI impact [1]. AI Opportunity (0/1): no AI revenue reported.

infinite_game.summary: SRX Global has just reinvented itself as an AI-driven holding platform, and there is no track record under the new strategy. The cause is shareholder-value framed and unvalidated, and multiple identity changes suggest a finite, opportunistic posture.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (0/3): stated aim is long-term shareholder value through investments; no vision of a better future state [1].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): no culture data and a recent wholesale strategic and leadership transition.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (1/2): abandoned its prior health and consumer business for an AI and crypto-oriented holding platform, though driven by opportunism rather than a clear cause [1].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (0/2): no evidence of costly principled decisions.

investment_thesis: SRX Global at $1.61 and a $32.6M market cap is a micro-cap that completed the EMJX acquisition on June 18, 2026 and repositioned as an AI-driven holding platform [1]. Upside is purely optionality on capital allocation and the AI and technology narrative.
thesis_continued: The bear case is opacity: no revenue growth, ROE or leverage data are available, profit margin is 0.0%, and the platform has no operating track record under the new strategy. Micro-cap size, thin recent trading (450K recent volume vs 3.9M average), and a rapid rebrand heighten dilution and governance risk. Scores are limited by sparse data.
key_catalysts: Disclosure of acquired EMJX operating results and first audited financials under the new structure [1]
Accretive capital allocation into high-conviction operating assets [1]
Reporting of concrete AI deployment or revenue [1]
key_risks: Extremely limited financial disclosure and unclear business model after rebrand [1]
Micro-cap liquidity and dilution risk from share issuances tied to the EMJX deal [1]
Strategic drift: repeated pivots without proven execution [1]
